messages:
Sasha: Quick sweep — who actually owns the Dedicated reservation for customer Nimbus? Need clarity on shipment + rack + network timelines for next-week onboarding. :eyes:
Raj: I’m primary on procurement. Shipping ETA moved to Tue 2025-04-01 (courier updated). Customs holding window looks like 24–48h currently. Will update if that slips.
Evan: Infra note — racks are staged at DC2, we have 6 chassis reserved but power circuit vendor is scheduled Thu 2025-03-27 morning. Still need final patch-panel mapping + cable kit. PR for rack layout: #612 (needs review).
Michelle: Network: VPC peering & NAT path is my action. I need the customer IP range from account team to finish firewall rules. If they don’t provide by EOD today, we’ll block on provisioning.
Sasha: Copy. Raj — can you push customs eta updates into the capacity ticket so ops has a single source of truth?
ops-bot: Created ticket CC-4523: "Nimbus Dedicated - shipment & rack onboarding" and linked to infra PR #612.
Raj: Done — CC-4523 updated with courier tracking + expected customs clear. Also flagged for expedited customs broker in case of delay.
Evan: I’ll pick up post-rack smoke tests (kernel + nvlink check). Plan: smoke script run, then perf burn for 30m. Will post results here.
Sasha: Who owns the Redwood Console reservation entry? Need instance names + model variants so routing policies can be pre-wired.
Raj: I can seed the console with reservation meta: res-nimbus-2025, model: h100-80gb, count: 6. Evan/Michelle confirm rack & network IDs and I’ll finalize.
Michelle: Confirming network side we’ll advertise via peering bgp ASN 64512, and firewall group fw-nimbus-prod.
Evan: Rack IDs: 23-B (primary), 23-C (fallback). Patch map attached in PR #612.
Sasha: Great. Action items: Raj -> keep CC-4523 updated with customs; Evan -> run smoke + post logs; Michelle -> finalize firewall rules once account IPs arrive; Raj -> create console reservation (tag res-nimbus-2025) once Evan confirms rack IDs.
Raj: Will do. If customs holds >48h we’ll request broker expedite.
Evan: ETA for smoke run is Thu 2025-03-27 afternoon after power work.
Sasha: Thanks — tagging @solutions-team for heads up on timeline. :thumbsup:
Michelle: Sending firewall template now (small snippet):
```
firewall_group: fw-nimbus-prod
allowed_src: [10.12.0.0/20, CUSTOMER_BLOCK]
rules:
  - tcp: 22,443,10250
```
Sasha: Perfect. Ping here when console entry is live and when smoke logs are uploaded.
Raj: Console entry created: dedicated/nimbus/res-nimbus-2025 (pending final sync). Marking owner: Raj.
Evan: Smoke logs uploaded to CC-4523 and linked in the ticket. All green on hardware/verif.
Sasha: Awesome — marking this as "handoff-ready" for Solutions to schedule onboarding next-week. Thanks everyone. :party:
